note: The Decision Authority layer (Fresco): not just the outcome but the LOGIC — why a batch was released or rejected. Empty now; each real engineering decision is added with full reasoning. A criterion that recurs across many decisions becomes a Mechanism Candidate (from data, not impression). decision_shift in the live DB is the outcome; this is the reasoning behind it.

decision_shape.question: what was being decided
decision_shape.reasoning: why this decision over the alternatives
criteria: the decision criteria used — these are what aggregate into Mechanism Candidates
